dedupe_keys.name: waka kotahi nz transport agency open data portal

description: The Waka Kotahi NZ Transport Agency open data portal publishes the agency's datasets. On 2026-09-29 its search API listed 21 items, including quarter-hourly state highway traffic volumes for January 2013 to September 2020, October 2020 to January 2022 and February 2022 to January 2025, daily traffic counts, heavy vehicle counts and monitoring sites, the Crash Analysis System (CAS) data, the Motor Vehicle Register, the national road centreline with road controlling authorities, NZTA highway information, contract price adjustment indices, and surveys on road safety attitudes and COVID-19 travel. Most items carry CC BY 4.0, while a few have custom licences. Coverage: New Zealand, mainly state highways. Format and access: downloads and APIs without registration. Licence and cost: free, mostly CC BY 4.0. Caveats: check each item's licence and period. It supports network flow, hazard exposure and resilience studies of the New Zealand road network. It relates to the NZTA traffic monitoring volumes and the state highway liquefaction exposure data in the catalogue.
